vertical: MTD for income tax compliance (sole traders and landlords)

evidence.excerpt: These Regulations make provision requiring the use of software to deliver information relating to income tax to His Majesty’s Revenue and Customs (“HMRC”) and to keep related records.

buyer_hypothesis.who: c. 2.9m sole traders and landlords phased in from April 2026 (HMRC MTD ITSA estimates; qualifying income over 50k first)

event_hypothesis.what: compulsory quarterly digital filing, software cost, points-based late-submission penalties (paired SI uksi/2026/370)
